entry.name: dropfile
entry.description: dropfile defines a region for dragging and dropping files into and then outputs the filepath and filetype upon file input.

attributes.digest: Sets file type list
attributes.description: The word, followed by one or moresets theobject to search for the specified file type(s) and opens a standard dialog window. Example type codes for files arefor text files,for Max binary format patcher files, andfor AIFF format audio files.with no arguments makes the object accept all file types, which is the default setting.

messages.name: (drag)
messages.description: When a file icon is dragged from the Finder or Max File Browser onto aobject in a locked patcher window, the object checks the file's type against those that it has been told to accept. If the file is of an acceptable type, the outline of thebox is highlighted. If the mouse button is released while the cursor is inside thebox, theobject outputs the type and full pathname of the file out its outlets.
